text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The challenge for the Twinkle Series 
begins alongside Gold City, an Umamusume 
currently shining brightly as an active 
model.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her work schedule was brutal. Yet even 
amidst the busyness, her enthusiasm and 
dedication toward training remained 
exceptionally high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'm not just some pretty doll. I'll prove 
it with my running," she declared.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show 'em the real me—" Thus begins 
the days of proving her true strength.
